   Strict gender roles can lead to internalized stereotypes, affecting self-esteem, career choices, and relationships. For example, societal expectations may steer women away from STEM fields or discourage men from expressing vulnerability.

   Gender roles intersect with other aspects of identity, such as race, class, and sexuality. For instance, Black women or LGBTQ+ individuals may face compounded discrimination based on both their gender and other social identities.
